arguments.message:
To set up a custom domain for your support portal, go to **Settings → General → Custom domain** and enter the domain you want to use. The page will display the exact DNS records you need to add at your DNS provider:

1. **CNAME record** – points the subdomain you chose (e.g., support.yourcompany.com) to Meridian’s portal address.
2. **TXT record** – used to verify that you own the domain before the custom domain is activated.

Add both records with your DNS host. Verification runs automatically and may take up to your provider’s propagation time; you’ll see a “pending” or “verified” status on the custom domain settings page.

If you need any further help, just let us know!
